methods_quotes.q: Age-adjusted death rates are per 100,000 standard population.
The denominators for these rates are paid, civilian worker populations aged 16–64 years in each usual occupation group
Usual occupation narratives were coded to standardized 2012 Census Occupation Codes, then collapsed into 22 broad occupation groups.
